💡 This work reveals electric-field-induced deformation in PAM hydrogel electrolytes via Zn–O/Zn–N adhesion, causing interfacial separation and reduced battery life. item.title: Particle Size Dictates Transport Mechanism and Performance in Li 6 PS 5 Cl Conversion Cathodes for All‐Solid‐State Batteries
item.description:

💡 Particle size non-monotonically governs Li transport in Li₆PS₅Cl conversion cathodes: rate capability first drops, then recovers in the ultrafine regime, alongside cycling stability. This reveals an interfacial job-sharing mechanism adding coupled ion/electron transport, distinct from degrading bulk pathways. The optimized cathode achieves 1096 Wh kg⁻¹ with ~100% capacity retention over 100 cycles, resolving whether LPSCl conversion enables high-capacity all-solid-state energy storage.

💡 This work pioneers a crystallinity regulation strategy for ionic liquid-based quasi-solid polymer electrolytes, tuning PMMA/PVDF-HFP ratios to co-optimize transparency and ionic transport. The optimal membrane achieves 88.2% transmittance, 1.91×10⁻⁴ S cm⁻¹ conductivity, and 0.55 Li⁺ transference number, enabling flexible transparent lithium-ion batteries with 300-cycle lifespan, 61.2% transparency, and 44.8 µWh cm⁻² energy density—advancing high-performance flexible transparent energy storage.
🏷 quasi-solid electrolyte · ionic liquid · crystallinity regulation · flexible transparent battery · PMMA

item.title: Long-duration aqueous manganese metal anode by hydrogel solvation regulation
item.description:

Science Advances | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces a hydrogel electrolyte with 18-crown-6 macrocycles that reshape Mn²⁺ solvation, cutting hydration from 5.51 to 1.39 and enabling water-repelling ion transport. It suppresses hydrogen evolution and Mn corrosion, delivering 95% Coulombic efficiency over 350 cycles, 1800-hour cycling, and durable pouch cells. This offers a promising solvation-regulation strategy for practical aqueous manganese metal batteries.
🏷 aqueous manganese battery · hydrogel electrolyte · solvation regulation · 18-crown-6 · Mn anode

💡 Phase engineering of ZrO₂ (tetragonal vs. monoclinic) is the key novelty: tetragonal ZrO₂'s oxygen vacancies and lower work function tune polyiodide adsorption–conversion balance. This suppresses shuttling while accelerating I₂/I⁻ kinetics, yielding 215 mAh g⁻¹ with 97% retention over 2000 cycles. It establishes crystal-phase engineering as a viable route to regulate interfacial electronic structure in aqueous conversion-type batteries.

item.title: Degradation-Informed Surface Coating Strategies for Recycled Lithium-Ion Battery Materials
item.description:
این مقاله راهبردهای پوشش سطحی مبتنی بر شناخت تخریب را برای مواد باتری لیتیوم-یونی بازیافتی بررسی می‌کند تا چرخه عمر پایدار باتری ممکن شود.
Energy & Environmental Science | ⭐ Review
💡 The novelty lies in linking specific degradation modes of recycled lithium-ion battery materials to tailored surface coating strategies, rather than applying virgin-material coatings indiscriminately. Its significance is enabling direct, hydrometallurgical, and pyrometallurgical recycling routes to restore electrochemical performance and durability, thereby advancing sustainable battery lifecycles and critical resource recovery.
🏷 battery recycling · surface coating · cathode degradation · direct recycling · hydrometallurgy

item.title: Cu/Ti/Al tripartite synergistic O3-typeNaNi 0.3 Fe 0.2 Mn 0.5 O 2 for sodium-ion batteries with high energy-density and cyclic-stability
item.description:

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Cu/Ti/Al tripartite synergy in O3-type NaNi0.3Fe0.2Mn0.5O2 enables kilogram-scale synthesis of a cathode with enhanced structural robustness, high energy density, and stable cycling. This advances practical sodium-ion batteries by combining scalable solid-state production with improved performance, addressing key barriers to commercialization.

item.title: Homogeneous regeneration of spent LiFePO 4 via in situ Al/F impurity introduction: tailoring Li–Fe anti-sites for great cycling stability
item.description:
هم‌آمیزی جزئی Al/F در LiFePO4 مستعمل نقص‌های آنتی‌سایت را تنظیم و نفوذ Li+ را تسریع می‌کند؛ کاتد بازتولیدشده 141.78 mAh g−1 در 1.0C و پایداری چرخه‌ای بالا می‌دهد.
Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Trace Al/F co-doping during spent LiFePO4 regeneration tailors Li–Fe antisite defects, lowering charge-transfer resistance and boosting Li+ diffusion. This in situ impurity-introduction strategy enables homogeneous regeneration, delivering 141.78 mAh g−1 at 1.0C with >90% capacity retention over 500 cycles, offering a scalable, low-cost route to high-performance recycled cathodes.
🏷 LiFePO4 regeneration · spent cathode · Al/F co-doping · antisite defects · cycling stability

item.title: Pyridoxal phosphate-mediated organic–inorganic hybrid interphase for highly stable aqueous zinc-ion batteries
item.description:
افزودنی PLP با تنظیم سولواتاسیون Zn2+ و جذب ترجیحی روی سطح Zn (002)، رسوب یکنواخت و عمر چرخه‌ای طولانی آند روی در باتری آبی یون-روی را ممکن می‌کند.
Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 PLP uniquely combines solvation regulation with facet-selective adsorption on Zn(002), forming an organic–inorganic hybrid interphase. This dual mechanism suppresses dendrites and side reactions, enabling highly stable, long-cycle-life aqueous zinc-ion batteries—advancing sustainable energy storage.
🏷 zinc-ion battery · zinc anode · pyridoxal phosphate · solvation regulation · Zn (002) deposition

item.title: Dynamic‐Coupling Axial Chloride on Dual‐Heteroatom Sites for Highly Anti‐Chloride Oxygen Reduction in Seawater
item.description:
کاتالیزورهای دو-هترواتمی FeMn با کوئوردیناسیون محوری کلر، فعالیت ORR در آب دریا را با پتانسیل نیم‌موج ۰.۹۴۱ V و پایداری بالا در باتری Zn-air بهبود می‌دهند.
Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers a dynamic axial Cl coordination strategy using O-bridged FeMn dual-heteroatom catalysts to overcome chloride poisoning in seawater ORR. The Cl−FeN3−O1−MnN3 structure enables fast four-electron kinetics and suppresses Fe corrosion, achieving 0.941 V half-wave potential and 30,000-cycle stability. The approach is generalizable to Co, Ni, and Cu systems, advancing sustainable seawater energy conversion.
🏷 seawater ORR · dual-heteroatom catalysts · axial chloride · Zn-air battery · anti-chloride poisoning

item.title: Polymer Side‐Chain Electronic Effects Regulating Solvation Sheath for Low‐Temperature and High‐Voltage Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:
زنجیره‌های جانبی الکترون‌کشنده تری‌فلورومتیل در GPE با کاهش سد بی‌حلال‌شدن Li+ و تشکیل LiF، باتری لیتیوم-فلز را در دمای پایین و ولتاژ بالا پایدار می‌کند.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work pioneers tuning polymer side-chain electronic effects to regulate Li⁺ solvation in gel electrolytes. Electron-withdrawing trifluoromethyl chains weaken polymer-Li⁺ binding, lowering desolvation barriers and forming LiF-rich interphases. The resulting electrolyte enables stable cycling at −20°C and high voltage, offering a new design paradigm for safe, high-energy-density lithium metal batteries in extreme environments.
🏷 gel polymer electrolyte · lithium metal battery · side-chain electronic effect · desolvation barrier · low-temperature electrolyte
